Then bring Kreenig Snarlsnout's Tusk to Thork at the Crossroads.

quests.name: Mahren Skyseer

quests.name: Serena Bloodfeather

quests.name: The Stagnant Oasis

quests.name: Ishamuhale

quests.name: The Barrens Oases
objectivesText: Speak with Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads.

objectivesText: Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun of Ratchet wants you to collect 10 Theramore Medals and slay Captain Fairmount, Cannoneer Whessan and Cannoneer Smythe.

quests.name: Weapons of Choice
objectivesText: Bring a Razormane Backstabber, a Charred Razormane Wand and a Razormane War Shield to Tatternack Steelforge at Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.

quests.name: Free From the Hold
objectivesText: Safely escort Gilthares Firebough back to Captain Brightsun in Ratchet.

quests.name: Prowlers of the Barrens
objectivesText: Collect 7 Prowler Claws from Savannah Prowlers for Sergra Darkthorn in the Crossroads.

quests.name: The Angry Scytheclaws
objectivesText: Kill Sunscale raptors and collect their feathers. Use the feathers on the 3 Scytheclaw nests. Return to Sergra Darkthorn in the Crossroads.

quests.name: Betrayal from Within
objectivesText: Bring Lok's Skull to Thork at the Crossroads in the Barrens.

quests.name: Enraged Thunder Lizards
objectivesText: Bring 3 Thunder Lizard Blood to Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo.

quests.name: Cry of the Thunderhawk
objectivesText: Find and slay a Thunderhawk, return its wings to Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo.

quests.name: The Demon Seed
objectivesText: Grab a Flawed Power Stone. Bring it to the Altar of Fire before the stone expires, then return to Ak'Zeloth.

quests.name: Letter to Jin'Zil
objectivesText: Deliver Darsok's letter to Jin'Zil within his cave in Malaka'Jin, in Stonetalon.

quests.name: Cenarius' Legacy
objectivesText: Kill 4 Sons of Cenarius, 4 Daughters of Cenarius and 4 Cenarion Botanists for Braelyn Firehand near Sun Rock Retreat.

quests.name: Ordanus
objectivesText: Bring Ordanus' head to Braelyn Firehand near Sun Rock Retreat.

quests.name: The Den
objectivesText: Travel to the Den on Stonetalon Peak. Using the Gatekeeper's Key, obtain the druids' hidden items. Use these items to open the Talon Den Hoard.

quests.name: The Swarm Grows
objectivesText: Deliver Korran's Sealed Note to Belgrom Rockmaul in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: The Swarm Grows
objectivesText: Deliver Belgrom's Sealed Note to Moktar Krin in Thousand Needles.

quests.name: The Swarm Grows
objectivesText: Kill 5 Silithid Searchers, 5 Silithid Hive Drones, and 5 Silithid Invaders and return to Moktar Krin in Thousand Needles.

quests.name: A New Ore Sample
objectivesText: Find an Unrefined Ore Sample on a Gravelsnout Digger or Surveyor and bring it to Tatternack Steelforge at Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.

quests.name: Identifying the Brood
objectivesText: Draz'Zilb in Brackenwall Village would like you to bring him 15 Searing Tongues and 15 Searing Hearts.

quests.name: The Brood of Onyxia
objectivesText: Speak with Overlord Mok'Morokk in Brackenwall Village.

quests.name: The Brood of Onyxia
objectivesText: Speak with Draz'Zilb in Brackenwall Village.

quests.name: The Brood of Onyxia
objectivesText: Draz'Zilb in Brackenwall Village wants you to destroy 5 Eggs of Onyxia.

quests.name: Challenge Overlord Mok'Morokk
objectivesText: Defeat Mok'Morokk and report the news to Draz'Zilb in Brackenwall Village.

quests.name: The Lost Report
objectivesText: Bring the Spy's Report to Nazeer Bloodpike in Brackenwall Village.

quests.name: The Severed Head
objectivesText: Bring the Defiant Orc Head to Nazeer Bloodpike in Brackenwall Village.

quests.name: The Troll Witchdoctor
objectivesText: Take the Defiant Orc Head to Kin'weelay in the Grom'gol Base Camp in Stranglethorn Vale.

quests.name: The Black Shield
objectivesText: Bring the Blackened Iron Shield to Krog in Brackenwall Village.

quests.name: Marg Speaks
objectivesText: Bring the Jeweled Pendant to Nazeer in Brackenwall Village.

quests.name: Report to Zor
objectivesText: Bring the Jeweled Pendant to Zor Lonetree in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: The Black Shield
objectivesText: Show the Blackened Iron Shield to Do'gol in Brackenwall Village.

quests.name: The Black Shield
objectivesText: Acquire 5 Acidic Venom Sacs for Do'gol in Brackenwall Village.

quests.name: The Black Shield
objectivesText: Talk with Krog in Brackenwall Village.

quests.name: Threat From the Sea
objectivesText: Speak to Katar in the Swamp of Sorrows.

quests.name: Pool of Tears
objectivesText: Fel'zerul in Stonard wants you to gather 10 Atal'ai Artifacts.

quests.name: Threat From the Sea
objectivesText: Kill 10 Marsh Murlocs, 10 Marsh Inkspewer, and 10 Marsh Flesheater, then return to Katar in the Swamp of Sorrows.

quests.name: Threat From the Sea
objectivesText: Speak with Tok'Kar in the Swamp of Sorrows.

quests.name: Continued Threat
objectivesText: Kill 10 Marsh Inkspewers, 10 Marsh Flesheaters, and 10 Marsh Oracles, then return to Katar in the Swamp of Sorrows.

quests.name: The Atal'ai Exile
objectivesText: Bring the Bundle of Atal'ai Artifacts to the Atal'ai Exile in the Hinterlands.

quests.name: Return to Fel'Zerul
objectivesText: Return to Fel'Zerul in Stonard.

quests.name: The Temple of Atal'Hakkar
objectivesText: Collect 20 Fetishes of Hakkar and bring them to Fel'Zerul in Stonard.

quests.name: The Corrupter
objectivesText: Bring the Flayed Demon Skin to Maurin Bonesplitter in Desolace.

quests.name: The Corrupter
objectivesText: Bring a Shadowstalker Scalp to Maurin Bonesplitter in Desolace.

quests.name: The Corrupter
objectivesText: Bring an Oracle Crystal to Maurin Bonesplitter in Desolace.

quests.name: The Corrupter
objectivesText: Speak to Takata Steelblade in Desolace.

quests.name: The Corrupter
objectivesText: Slay Lord Azrethoc and Jugkar Grim'rod and return to Takata Steelblade in Desolace.

quests.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
objectivesText: Bring the Secure Crate to Wharfmaster Dizzywig in Ratchet.

quests.name: A Peon's Burden
objectivesText: Bring Ukor's Burden to Innkeeper Grosk in Razor Hill.

quests.name: The Disgraced One
objectivesText: Speak to Dispatch Commander Ruag in Stonard.

quests.name: The Missing Orders
objectivesText: Speak to Bengor.

quests.name: The Swamp Talker
objectivesText: Retrieve the Warchief's Orders and return them to the Fallen Hero of the Horde.

quests.name: Rin'ji is Trapped!
objectivesText: Escort Rin'ji out of the Quel'Danil Lodge, then find his hidden secret at the Overlook Cliffs to the east.

quests.name: Rin'ji's Secret
objectivesText: Oran Snakewrithe, a well known scholar on matters concerning the Witherbark trolls, may be able to decipher the tablet. She is known to reside within the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.

quests.name: Fall From Grace
objectivesText: Listen to the Fallen Hero of the Horde tell his story.

quests.name: War on the Woodpaw
objectivesText: Bring 10 Woodpaw Gnoll Manes to Hadoken Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.

quests.name: Alpha Strike
objectivesText: Kill 5 Woodpaw Alphas and return to Hadoken Swiftstrider within one hour.

quests.name: Woodpaw Investigation
objectivesText: Find the gnoll battle plans somewhere in the gnoll camps to the south of Camp Mojache.

quests.name: The Battle Plans
objectivesText: Bring the Woodpaw Battle Plans to Hadoken Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.

quests.name: Venom Bottles
objectivesText: Bring a Venom Bottle to an apothecary in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Undamaged Venom Sac
objectivesText: Bring an Undamaged Venom Sac to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Consult Master Gadrin
objectivesText: Speak with Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.

quests.name: The Spider God
objectivesText: Read from the Tablet of Theka to learn the name of the Witherbark spider god, then return to Master Gadrin.

quests.name: Summoning Shadra
objectivesText: Defeat Shadra at the altar of Shadra'Alor, then bring her venom to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Venom to the Undercity
objectivesText: Bring Faranell's Parcel to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.

quests.name: A New Cloak's Sheen
objectivesText: Bring 10 Iridescent Sprite Darter Wings to Krueg Skullsplitter in Camp Mojache.

quests.name: A Grim Discovery
objectivesText: Bring 20 Grimtotem Horns to Krueg Skullsplitter in Camp Mojache.

quests.name: The Ogres of Feralas
objectivesText: Rok Orhan in Camp Mojache wants you to kill 10 Gordunni Ogres, 10 Gordunni Ogre-Magi, and 5 Gordunni Brutes.

quests.name: A Grim Discovery
objectivesText: Bring the Crate of Grimtotem Horns to Belgrom Rockmaul in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: The Gordunni Scroll
objectivesText: Bring the Gordunni Scroll to Rok Orhan in Camp Mojache.

quests.name: Dark Ceremony
objectivesText: Rok Orhan in Camp Mojache wants you to find a Gordunni Orb.

quests.name: The Ogres of Feralas
objectivesText: Rok Orhan in Camp Mojache wants you to kill 10 Gordunni Shaman, 10 Gordunni Warlocks, and 5 Gordunni Maulers.

quests.name: A Threat in Feralas
objectivesText: Belgrom Rockmaul wants you to speak with Rok Orhan in Camp Mojache.

quests.name: The Gordunni Orb
objectivesText: Bring the Gordunni Orb to Uthel'nay in the Darkbriar Lodge in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: A Strange Request
objectivesText: Take the Shrunken Head to Neeru Fireblade in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: Return to Witch Doctor Uzer'i
objectivesText: Deliver Neeru's Herb Pouch to Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Feralas.

quests.name: Testing the Vessel
objectivesText: Travel to the Hinterlands, and locate the Wildkin. Kill 10, and use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture the fallen Wildkin.
Bring 10 Wildkin Muiseks and the Muisek Vessel to Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Feralas.

quests.name: Hippogryph Muisek
objectivesText: Kill 10 Frayfeather Hippogryphs of any type, then use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture them.

quests.name: Faerie Dragon Muisek
objectivesText: Kill 8 Sprite Darters or Sprite Dragons. Use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture the fallen Faerie Dragons.

quests.name: Treant Muisek
objectivesText: Kill 3 Wandering Forest Walkers. Use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture the fallen Treants.

quests.name: Mountain Giant Muisek
objectivesText: Kill 7 Land Walkers or Cliff Giants. Use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture the fallen Mountain Giants.

quests.name: Natural Materials
objectivesText: Bring 2 Splintered Logs, 6 Encrusted Minerals, 20 pieces of Resilient Sinew, and 40 Metallic Fragments to Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Camp Mojache.

quests.name: Weapons of Spirit
objectivesText: Witch Doctor Uzer'i wants you to wait for a moment while he prepares the weapons.

quests.name: Jorn Skyseer
objectivesText: Speak with Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo.

quests.name: Stolen Silver
objectivesText: Bring the Stolen Silver to Gazrog in the Crossroads.

quests.name: Mura Runetotem
objectivesText: Speak with Mura Runetotem in the Sepulcher.

quests.name: Stealing Knowledge
objectivesText: Find the Tablet of Beth'Amara, the Tablet of Jin'yael, the Tablet of Markri, and the Tablet of Sael'hai before returning to Jediga in Azshara.

quests.name: Delivery to Magatha
objectivesText: Bring the Tablet of Beth'Amara to Magatha in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: Delivery to Jes'rimon
objectivesText: Bring the Tablet of Jin'yael to Jes'rimon in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: Delivery to Andron Gant
objectivesText: Bring the Tablet of Markri to Andron Gant in Undercity.

quests.name: Delivery to Archmage Xylem
objectivesText: Bring the Tablet of Sael'hai to Archmage Xylem in Azshara.

quests.name: Magatha's Payment to Jediga
objectivesText: Deliver Magatha's Note to Jediga in Azshara.

quests.name: Jes'rimon's Payment to Jediga
objectivesText: Deliver Jes'rimon's Note to Jediga in Azshara.

quests.name: Andron's Payment to Jediga
objectivesText: Deliver Andron's Note to Jediga in Azshara.

quests.name: Xylem's Payment to Jediga
objectivesText: Deliver Xylem's Note to Jediga in Azshara.

quests.name: Counterattack!
objectivesText: Bring a Piece of Krom'zar's Banner to Regthar Deathgate, west of the Crossroads.

quests.name: Larion and Muigin
objectivesText: Hunt 5 Bloodpetal Lashers, 5 Bloodpetal Threshers, 5 Bloodpetal Flayers and 5 Bloodpetal Trappers for Larion at Marshal's Refuge.

quests.name: Zapper Fuel
objectivesText: Deliver the Unloaded Zapper and 5 samples of Atal'ai Haze to Larion in Marshal's Refuge.

quests.name: Marvon's Workshop
objectivesText: Travel to Marvon Rivetseeker's workshop in Ratchet.

quests.name: Galgar's Cactus Apple Surprise
objectivesText: Bring Galgar 10 Cactus Apples. You remember him saying that they could be found near cactuses.

quests.name: Well of Corruption
objectivesText: Collect a sample of corrupted water from the Jadefire Satyrs' moonwell and bring it to Winna Hazzard at Bloodvenom Post.

quests.name: Corrupted Sabers
objectivesText: Take Winna's kitten to the corrupted moonwell, release it, then bring it back to Winna.
Once you have returned to Winna, click on the cat to release it to Winna.

quests.name: Wild Guardians
objectivesText: Trull Failbane in Felwood wants you to kill 15 Raging Owlbeasts and 15 Ragged Owlbeasts.

quests.name: Message to Freewind Post
objectivesText: Bring the Urgent Message to Cliffwatcher Longhorn at Freewind Post.

quests.name: Your Place In The World
objectivesText: Speak with Gornek. You recall Kaltunk marking your map with his location and mentioning that Gornek resided in the Den, a building to the west.

quests.name: Wild Guardians
objectivesText: Trull Failbane in Felwood wants you to hunt 10 Berserk Owlbeasts in Winterspring.

quests.name: Wild Guardians
objectivesText: Trull Failbane in Felwood wants you to hunt 13 Moontouched Owlbeasts.

quests.name: Alien Egg
objectivesText: Return the Alien Egg to Hagar Lightninghoof in Freewind Post.

quests.name: Pacify the Centaur
objectivesText: Kill 12 Galak Scouts, 10 Galak Wranglers, and 6 Galak Windchasers, and then return to Cliffwatcher Longhorn in Freewind Post.

quests.name: Serpent Wild
objectivesText: Report your findings to Motega Firemane.

quests.name: Supplies for the Crossroads
objectivesText: Find and return Crossroads' Supply Crates to Thork in the Barrens.

quests.name: Blood Shards of Agamaggan
objectivesText: Bring a Blood Shard to Mangletooth in Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.
Collect more Blood Shards if you want him to bless you with Agamaggan's power.

quests.name: Ursius of the Shardtooth
objectivesText: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to kill Ursius.

quests.name: Brumeran of the Chillwind
objectivesText: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to kill Brumeran.

quests.name: Shy-Rotam
objectivesText: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to defeat Shy-Rotam.

quests.name: Sacred Fire
objectivesText: Gather 10 bushels of Incendia Agave, and then consult Magatha Grimtotem on Elder Rise in Thunderbluff.

quests.name: Grimtotem Spying
objectivesText: Locate and retrieve the three Secret Notes in Darkcloud Pinnacle.

quests.name: Arikara
objectivesText: Slay Arikara. Bring her remains and the Incendia powder to Motega Firemane in Whitereach Post as proof of your deed.

quests.name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
objectivesText: Seek out High Executor Derrington. His base camp is located at the Bulwark, east of Tirisfal Glade and the Undercity.

quests.name: Scarlet Diversions
objectivesText: Proceed to the Scarlet Crusade's base camp between Felstone Field and Dalson's Tears and destroy their command tent.
Place the Scourge banner at the camp, and then return to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: All Along the Watchtowers
objectivesText: Using the Beacon Torch, mark each tower in Andorhal; you will need to stand in the doorway of the tower to successfully mark it.
Once all four towers are marked, return the Beacon Torch to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: The Scourge Cauldrons
objectivesText: Speak with Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Target: Felstone Field
objectivesText: Go to Felstone Field in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there. It may have a key that will allow access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Felstone Field Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

quests.name: Return to the Bulwark
objectivesText: Bring the Filled Felstone Field Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Target: Dalson's Tears
objectivesText: Go to Dalson's Tears in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Dalson's Tears Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

quests.name: Return to the Bulwark
objectivesText: Bring the Filled Dalson's Tears Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Target: Writhing Haunt
objectivesText: Go to the Writhing Haunt in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Writhing Haunt Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

quests.name: Lazy Peons
objectivesText: Use the Foreman's Blackjack on Lazy Peons when they're sleeping. Wake up 5 peons, then return the Foreman's Blackjack to Foreman Thazz'ril in the Valley of Trials.

quests.name: The Champion of the Banshee Queen
objectivesText: Speak with Nathanos Blightcaller in the Eastern Plaguelands. He is said to have taken up residence at the Marris Stead.

quests.name: To Kill With Purpose
objectivesText: Travel to Corin's Crossing to the east and slaughter the Scourge that inhabit the town. Collect 7 pieces of Living Rot in under 10 minutes. Use the Mortar and Pestle to grind the Living Rot into Coagulated Rot.

quests.name: Un-Life's Little Annoyances
objectivesText: Slay 20 Noxious Plaguebats and 10 Monstrous Plaguebats. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller when you are finished.

quests.name: The Ranger Lord's Behest
objectivesText: Travel to the northern borders of the Eastern Plaguelands and recover the Quel'Thalas Registry. The item is somewhere in the Quel'Lithien lodge.
You must also slay 8 Rangers, 8 Pathstriders, and 8 Woodsmen.

quests.name: Duskwing, Oh How I Hate Thee...
objectivesText: Find Duskwing and slay him. From the corpse, recover a Patch of Duskwing's Fur and return it to Nathanos Blightcaller.
It is said that Duskwing roams the countryside to the north of Marris Stead.

quests.name: The Corpulent One
objectivesText: Find Borelgore in the northern wastes of Eastern Plaguelands and destroy him. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller when the mission is complete.

quests.name: The Call to Command
objectivesText: Travel to the Undercity and speak with Varimathras.

quests.name: The Crimson Courier
objectivesText: Return to Eastern Plaguelands and track down the Crimson Courier. Kill the Courier and recover the Grand Crusader's Command.
Take the command to Nathanos Blightcaller for further instruction.

quests.name: Nathanos' Ruse
objectivesText: Travel to Tyr's Hand, southeast of the Marris Stead. Once there, take a bite of the Rotten Apple. While under the guise of the Scarlet Crusade, deliver the Grand Crusader's Command to Crusader Lord Valdelmar.

quests.name: Return to Nathanos
objectivesText: Return to Nathanos Blightcaller with the new information.

quests.name: The Scarlet Oracle, Demetria
objectivesText: The Scarlet Crusade is on the move. Somewhere along the road from Tyr's Hand to Stratholme you will find the Oracle, Demetria, and her entourage. Hunt her down and slay her. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller should you succeed.

quests.name: The Ashenvale Hunt
objectivesText: Speak with Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post, Ashenvale.

quests.name: Thazz'ril's Pick
objectivesText: Bring Thazz'ril's Pick to Foreman Thazz'ril.

quests.name: Report to Kadrak
objectivesText: Report to Kadrak at the watch tower in northern Barrens.

quests.name: The Warsong Reports
objectivesText: Open the Bundle of Reports. Take the Warsong Reports to the Warsong Scout, Warsong Runner, and Warsong Outrider. Bring back the updates they give you to Kadrak at the northern watch tower in the barrens.

quests.name: A Strange One
objectivesText: Speak with Winna Hazzard in Felwood.

quests.name: Zukk'ash Infestation
objectivesText: Bring 20 Zukk'ash Carapaces to Hadoken Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, Feralas.

quests.name: Stinglasher
objectivesText: Defeat Stinglasher in the Writhing Deep, bringing its glands back to Hadoken Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, Feralas.

quests.name: Zukk'ash Report
objectivesText: Deliver the Camp Mojache Zukk'ash Report to Zilzibin Drumlore. He resides in the Drag of Orgrimmar.

quests.name: Message to the Wildhammer
objectivesText: Otho Moji'ko at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to slaughter 15 Highvale Outrunners, 15 Highvale Scouts, 15 Highvale Marksman and 15 Highvale Rangers. Return to him when this task is complete.
You can find the Highvale high elves at the Quel'Danil Lodge in the northwestern region of the Hinterlands.

quests.name: Another Message to the Wildhammer
objectivesText: Otho Moji'ko at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to bring him 10 Long Elegant Feathers from the gryphons that inhabit the Hinterlands. Return to him once this task is complete.
Gryphons are known to inhabit every region of the Hinterlands.

quests.name: The Final Message to the Wildhammer
objectivesText: Otho Moji'ko at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to travel to Aerie Peak in the western region of the Hinterlands and place the Final Message to the Wildhammer by the well in the center of town. Return to him once this task is complete.
Beware of angry Wildhammer dwarves and unruly members of the Alliance.

quests.name: Kidnapped Elder Torntusk!
objectivesText: Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to rescue her mate, Elder Torntusk, from Jintha'alor.
You have been told that he is being held prisoner atop Jintha'alor, the Vilebranch capital city located in the southern region of the Hinterlands.

quests.name: Recover the Key!
objectivesText: Elder Torntusk at Jintha'alor wants you to kill Hitah'ya the Keeper to get the Shackle Key to his bindings. Return to Elder Torntusk when you have recovered the key.

quests.name: Return to Primal Torntusk
objectivesText: Elder Torntusk at Jintha'alor wants you to return to Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village with news of his rescue.
